After having such a hard time making a decision as to what electric guitar to get as my first, (Had the Epi G400 Pro, Epi LP Standard Pro, Yamaha EG 112C, Squier Standard Tele, and Squier Standard Strat as my options) I decided to go on with the Squier Strat and honestly, as of the moment, I don't regret it.

Along with my Fender Mustang I amp, I get the different tones and sounds I want, whether it be classic rock, hard rock, funk, or punk, and so on and so forth. It might be worth nothing to others on here, but it's truly amazing to my ears (and eyes; the strat looks even better in real life!). And to top it off, it feels so good! Smooth neck, easy on the fingers all around the fretboard, good intonation, not too heavy...what's not to love?

Now, here are two minor questions I've been meaning to ask about this guitar, and hopefully someone will be able to help me out with them...

  • As I was removing the plastic that came with the pickguard, I realized there was a small part of it underneath the volume and tone knobs that wouldn't come off. Is there a way to remove the small pieces of plastic left there? Like, can I remove the knobs and take them off so as to stop the uncomfortable sound they make whenever I turn the knobs?

  • Judging from the serial number, when was my guitar manufactured? I checked it and it was ICS14297941. A brief research about squier product dating (which I would assume is the same as the fender product dating...is it?) makes me believe my guitar was made in 2014, but I don't get why it has both C and S. (It said in the product page that IC*** meant that it was made in Indonesia by Cort and IS*** meant that it was made in Indonesia by Samick. I have both letters...) Could it mean that my guitar is fake (which won't make me change my opinions on it whatsoever), or do they have a new way to produce serial numbers in current years?

Thanks to anyone who can help, and while I wait for replies, I'll be playing with this guy for a while. Quite a while. I'm just so happy to finally get an electric guitar of my own. :D
